title: Find Smallest Common Element in All Rows
description:
Given an `m x n` matrix `mat` where every row is sorted in **strictly** **increasing** order, return *the **smallest common element** in all rows*.

If there is no common element, return `-1`.
constraints: mat[i] is sorted in strictly increasing order.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Find Smallest Common Element in All Rows.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
